description: Standardized domain error codes and retry policies for OmniForge batch I/O operations.

IO.AccessDenied.recommendedAction: Prompt user for elevated file permissions or verify file is not marked read-only by OS.

IO.SharingViolation.recommendedAction: File is locked by another process (antivirus/editor). Retry with exponential backoff.

IO.PathTooLong.recommendedAction: Prefix path with \\?\ to enable Windows extended path syntax, or shorten destination path.

IO.NotFound.recommendedAction: File was deleted or moved prior to processing. Record warning and continue batch.

IO.DiskFull.recommendedAction: Target volume out of space. Abort batch immediately to prevent data corruption.
